name: Istiorachis
sum: An iguanodontian of the Early Cretaceous Wessex Formation of the Isle of Wight with greatly elongated neural spines forming a sail or ridge.
wsnote: Not given in the sources used.
holotype: A partial postcranial skeleton including several vertebrae, from the Wessex Formation, Isle of Wight.
biology: The name means "sail spine", for its tall neural spines; the naming paper discusses the origin of neural spine elongation in iguanodontians.
author: Lockwood et al. 2025
